Name: Atroth-shophan
ModernLocation: Rujm Ataruz, east of the Jordan
Description: A town in Gad's building list east of the Jordan, named with Atroth, Jaazer and Jogbehah among the cities Gad built for their flocks and families.
BiblicalSignificance: Atroth-shophan is a list-only town: Gad's settlement east of the Jordan, built for cattle and children before the conquest west of the river was finished.
